headline: Frontier Sectors Show Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement has come in Weathered Expanse, where 11 strategic-base events were recorded in the latest two hours and 61 across the day; its ledger now stands at four Colonial, three Warden, and two neutral bases. Mooring County remains unsettled, adding four events in two hours and 21 in six, while its balance has shifted to nine Warden and three Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage has also stirred, registering three events in the latest two hours after a quieter stretch, with 16 across the day. Palantine Berm retains a meaningful record of 15 daily events, including five in six hours, though none arrived in the latest two-hour window. Nevish Line remains divided at five Warden and three Colonial bases, with 21 daily events but no immediate movement. Kuura Strand’s 18-event daily record likewise lacks fresh activity. Heavy casualty pressure is still concentrated in Weathered Expanse, Mooring County, Callahan’s Passage, and other central sectors, but the present base ledger points chiefly to the first three as the active fronts.
